title: Low-Level Optimization Study — reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong Low-Level Optimization Study solution should meet the objective: Compare a high-level function with an equivalent Yul implementation in a local harness. Confirm equivalence with tests before measuring gas, and explain auditability costs. It should use a repeatable local test setup and explain why the selected rules preserve the intended behavior.
explanation: Review technical correctness, authorization, boundary behavior, repeatability, and limitation statements. Do not treat a passing demo as a comprehensive security assessment.

review_rubric.criterion: Technical correctness and fit to task
